newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Hi-Bred FY97 soybean sales up.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Hi-Bred FY97 soybean sales up.

text.p: Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc said Wednesday its soybean sales and margins in fiscal 1997 are significantly higher than a year ago.
It cited increased overall soybean acreage and strong demand for Pioneer soybeans.
Pioneer, a seed and agricultural genetics company, did not give sales or margin figures for soybeans.
Earlier, Pioneer reported earnings for the third quarter ended May 31 of $4.04 a share, up from $3.64 a year ago. For the first nine months it earned $3.46 a share, up from $3.10.
Pioneer said its operations in Europe continued to perform well, paced by strong performances in Italy, southern Europe and central Europe, Charles Johnson, chairman, said in a statement.
The company said growth continued in Asia in 1997, while operations in Mexico are making a strong recovery. Details on international peformance were not available.
Earlier, Pioneer said its leading North American seed corn market share is expected to be 42 to 42.5 percent in fiscal 1997, down one-and-a-half to two points from a year ago.
The company said several factors affected its market share, including the transition to a new lineup of genetics.
